text:
Samir Patel: opened PR to tidy the SOC2 audit-log doc: key management language, retention examples, and SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/909
Jules Huang: on it. Want to make the wording less product-specific and ensure snippets match the latest SDK shapes.
Ravi Kapoor: quick question 11 Should we prefer the term 'CMK' or spell out 'customer-managed key (CMK)' each time? Trying to balance brevity and clarity for non-security readers.
Maria Gomes (Legal): Legal prefers the first mention be the long form: 'customer-managed key (CMK)'. After that, CMK is fine. Also add a short advisory: "Customers must ensure KMS/HSM access controls follow least privilege."
Jules Huang: will update. Also found two mismatched examples: the JS snippet uses `audit.export({redact: true, keyId: '...'} )` but the CLI uses `redwood logs export --redact --kms-key-id=...`. Names diverged after SDK refactor.
Samir Patel: let's include explicit SDK version tags and keep both CLIs and SDK examples. People copy commands directly.
Ravi Kapoor: agree. I'll standardize function signatures to the latest public SDKs (Python v1.3.0, Go v0.9.1, JS v2.0.2) and add a note: "APIs may vary across releases; check SDK changelog."
Maria Gomes (Legal): Also update the retention example language. The sample currently says "7 years (example)", which sounds prescriptive. Suggest: "Hosted default: 1 year; configurable by contract; customers should consult legal/compliance for jurisdictional requirements."
docs-ci: build / docs:pr/909: queued
Jules Huang: draft snippet (Python v1.3.0):
Jules Huang: ```python
from redwood_audit import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
client.export_logs(start_ts=1680000000, end_ts=1682592000, redact_sensitive=True, cmk_id='projects/PROJECT/locations/REGION/keyRings/NAME/cryptoKeys/KEY')
```
Samir Patel: replace the GCP path with a clear placeholder as above. Also add a one-line line about tenant-scoped CMKs vs org-level CMKs.
Jules Huang: added. Also adding CLI example: `redwood logs export --since 2023-05-01 --until 2023-05-26 --redact-sensitive --kms-key=KEY_ID`
Ravi Kapoor: for Go snippet, please show context usage and error check, and label it "Go SDK v0.9.1".
Maria Gomes (Legal): please include the legal review note in the PR description: "Legal review: 2026-03-20 by M. Gomes" and add a short line in docs: "This page is informational and not legal advice."
Jules Huang: updated PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/909/files -- CI preview pending.
docs-ci: build / docs:pr/909: succeeded 44d staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/security/audit-logs#cmk
Ravi Kapoor: reviewed, left one nit about the encryption matrix table formatting.
Samir Patel: I'll run a quick smoke on staging to validate code blocks render and the anchor works.
Maria Gomes (Legal): approved wording. Thanks everyone.
Jules Huang: merging after small table fix. Will add redirects for the deprecated snippet URLs.
Samir Patel: merged. Changelog note: "Refined CMK phrasing, added SDK-versioned audit-export snippets, clarified default retention guidance."
